lines: Nurturing Brilliance - The Cummins Scholarship Program
Bridging financial gaps and nurturing future leaders
Since 2006, the Cummins India Foundation (CIF) has been empowering bright minds from underprivileged backgrounds to pursue professional degrees and diplomas in engineering.
Covers full tuition and related expenses without a predefined cap and ensures that every deserving student gets full support based on actual need, covering tuition and other essential expenses.
Scholars are guided by experienced professionals who align their mentoring with current industry expectations, grooming students for real-world success.
Seasoned Cummins volunteers commit to mentoring scholars throughout the program duration, providing consistent support and career guidance.
Each scholar receives tailored mentoring focused on academic, professional, and personal growth, fostering well-rounded development.
To bridge digital gaps; the program provides laptops to scholars, ensuring equal access to online learning resources and skill development.
Scholars gain access to a vibrant alumni network, facilitating peer learning, professional connections, and ongoing support beyond the program.
The program is committed to empowering, deserving students from diverse backgrounds, ensuring an inclusive platform for higher education and career advancement.
Family income not above ₹6 lakhs per annum
Studying in select locations: Ahilyanagar, Indore, Jamshedpur, Phaltan, Pune, Dharashiv, Vidisha, Guna, Osmanabad, Ranchi
No previous recipients from applicant’s family
As a natural extension of this initiative, the program has been expanded to support aspiring Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) under the banner of Nurturing Brilliance Wings.
At Cummins, “Wings” symbolizes our commitment to empowering Persons with Disabilities to rise beyond stereotypes, overcome limitations, and build meaningful careers.
With inclusion as one of our core values, we believe that talent exists in many forms, and every individual deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and soar.
Minimum 40% in all previous exams (relaxed criteria)

What expenses are covered under the scholarship?
The admission and tuition fees payable to the educational institution are covered under the Scholarship.
What expenses are not covered under the scholarship?
Below mentioned expenses are not covered under the Scholarship:

Private tuition fees, expenses for accommodation / hostel fee, mess charges, transport expenses. canteen or cafeteria charges and/ or deposits whether refundable / nonrefundable or caution money demanded by the Educational Institution etc.
What is the duration of the scholarship?

The student is eligible to receive Scholarship amount till the completion of his/her academic course for which he/ she is selected under the scholarship program. Provided that he/she secures an aggregate of minimum 60% in each academic year.
Does the beneficiary need to repay the scholarship amount or execute a bond with the Foundation?
No. The beneficiary does not need to repay the Scholarship amount or execute a bond with the Foundation.
What is the process of conducting the personal interview?

The Foundation shall arrange personal interviews of the candidates shortlisted after the initial screening and aptitude test. The personal interview will be conducted by a panel of three Cummins employees and panel will evaluate students based on technical and non-technical parameters.
Applications for the 2026–27 academic year will open on 1st July 2026.
